sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): crouched forward, the two scythe claws swinging with his steps, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as the pale figure has them
sheets.weapons: HIS CLAWS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the two long scythe claws with their pale pink-white blades veined in dark red, as long as in image 1 - raised, thrust, swept or folded as the pale figure holds them; the wings on his back and the two teal antennae as in image 1, folded or spread as the pale figure has them. The claws are NOT legs: his two legs with the copper clawed feet carry him. Only him: no void glow, no afterimages, no camouflage shimmer (his R) - every frame shows him whole and solid.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the legs EXACTLY as the pale figure has them in this frame: which leg is in front and which behind, which foot is flat on the ground line and which is lifted (image 3: the near leg lighter, the far leg darker). Frame 2: the legs EXACTLY as the pale figure has them in this frame: which leg is in front and which behind, which foot is flat on the ground line and which is lifted (image 3: the near leg lighter, the far leg darker). The two legs TAKE TURNS as in the old run: the near leg (the lighter one) and the far leg (the darker one) pass each other, the leg in front changing over the 8 frames - never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」). His scythe claws swing down near the ground but are NOT legs: his two legs with the copper clawed feet carry him.
